title: Village Liberation
description: Elder Tala, leader of a Twi'lek village in Tann Province, needs help. The criminal syndicate has been oppressing her village for too long—taking resources, intimidating her people, leaving them with nothing. The thugs are based in The Syndicate Mines, using it as their base of operations. The New Republic says they'll help, but they need action now. Can you help drive out the syndicate thugs from their stronghold?
shortDescription: Liberate a Twi'lek village by clearing The Syndicate Mines

objectives.description: Speak with Elder Tala about the village's situation and learn about The Syndicate Mines
Travel to The Syndicate Mines where the thugs are based
Clear The Syndicate Mines of all syndicate thugs
Defeat the syndicate boss controlling the mines
Recover the stolen Twi'lek cultural artifact from the mines
Return to Elder Tala with news of the mines' liberation
